_comment: ENX Gateway MCP - template for attaching the Euronext internal gateway MCP server to a Foundry agent. Fill server_url with the tenant's gateway MCP endpoint. READ-ONLY CHARTER (governance/HUMAN_APPROVAL.md Layer 1, DATA_PROTECTION_GUARDRAILS section 2): allowed_tools MUST contain ONLY read tools - attach_integrations.py calls the gateway's tools/list before attaching and refuses any tool whose annotations lack readOnlyHint=true unless the connection is named in that agent's write_connections (no agent has any). Placeholders in {braces} are tenant-specific values. Auth: this definition carries NO headers - Foundry MCP tools take server_label/server_url/allowed_tools only; the bearer token is fetched from Key Vault (secret {kv-secret-name-enx-gateway-token}) at RUN time and passed as tool_resources.mcp[].headers by the caller (Logic Apps HTTP body, mcp-server/server.py, smoke_test.py via _azure_helpers.mcp_run_headers()). Never commit a real token.
_require_approval_justification: 'never' is safe ONLY because every allow-listed tool is read-only by construction (readOnlyHint check at attach time + gateway-side read-only policy for this project). If the gateway ever exposes a write tool to this project, list it under write_connections of a specific agent AND set require_approval to 'always' - the approval then lands in the same human gate as the workflows (kind MCP_WRITE in team/approval-policy.json).
_verification: python3 scripts/attach_integrations.py --dry-run --list-mcp-tools prints each allow-listed tool with its readOnlyHint; tools without it fail the run.
